recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future cleanup of dormant ConsentDirective source files or current Consent maturity/status wording should be handled under a current build-scope work-group issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7531 was a Published/Persuasive 2015May FHIR-core Contract issue from CBCC asking that old ConsentDirective ballot material be explicitly marked as draft and to be revised in DSTU 2.1, with a connectathon focus. Its final resolution says CBCC was actively working toward a DSTU 2.1 ballot with an implementation guide.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly citing FHIR-7531 was found. The historical application appears in the broader ConsentDirective follow-up path: the 2015May page was a sparse Consent Directive profile on Contract, 5a390b2596 added a draft Privacy Consent Directive IG entry, acc3f3137b introduced Consent as a resource rather than a Contract profile, later commits documented and refined Consent, and 94445ca431 recorded that ConsentDirective became Consent.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini lists Consent and Contract as active resources, has no active consentdirective profile entry, and records ConsentDirective became Consent. source/igs.xml keeps the old PCD IG entry commented, and source/guides/pcd is absent. Current Consent source contains Scope and Usage, Privacy Consent Directive background, examples, and a Consent StructureDefinition. Companion ConsentDirective/Contract audits for FHIR-7532, FHIR-7533, FHIR-7253, and FHIR-7871 are already on the combined branch; FHIR-6284 was decided here as the same direct migration family.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding a 2015 DSTU 2.1 draft warning to current Consent would be stale, and editing dormant ConsentDirective/PCD files would not change the current build.
